about: Every case the world setting readers run: the Python reader (exulanica/world/world_settings.py) and the browser's (web/packages/atlas-core/src/world-setting.ts) read each setting and apply it to its pack, and must reach the same verdict: the same refusal reason and path, or the same digest of the setting and of the pack as drawn. The look families and texture sets are the style pack cases' (assets/style-packs/manifest-cases.v1.json context).
